candidates.change_summary: Use jojoTeam instead of msg.sender as the owner of the new EmergencyOracle, so the deployed oracle's owner (observable via owner()) differs.
Invert the access-control check so only callers who are NOT the JOJO team can create oracles, changing who can trigger the observable event and deployment.
Remove the require check so any caller can create an emergency oracle, exposing the guarded deployment to arbitrary callers.
